pages.text: A desk radio for the 2 m band with more power than a handheld. It needs $(l:radiocraft:power/overview)power$(/l) (2 FE/t listening, 13 transmitting) and an antenna on $(l:radiocraft:antennas/coax)coax$(/l): a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/vhf_antennas)J-pole, Slim Jim or Yagi$(/l).$(br2)The right-hand display shows the repeater $(thing)offset$() (OFS) and $(thing)tone$(); the soft buttons and big knobs change them.

pages.name: Base station and J-pole
pages.text: The J-pole matches the whole 2 m band (SWR 1).
